axes.name: decl
axes.rationale: Declaration order changes MSC frame slot assignment; target frame is 10 bytes

axes.name: body
axes.rationale: Different spellings of record = base + i*0x2c change which subexpression the loop optimizer strength-reduces and anchors

spec.semantic_summary: Batch: byte-array indexing with i*0x2c as the common record-base subexpression (direct, sizeof, byte pointer, struct cast, int k) so the induction anchors at offset 0 and homes in DS:SI
binding_evidence: Candidate declarations and source comments; inspect packet bindings before acceptance

promotion: NONE: independent rebuild and recipe review required
